4188-4644-7791.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
4188-4644-7791.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Accomplished Alchemist.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

2724-3217-5900.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Lilysplash Mentor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1636-1689-2519-3891.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Mentor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1636-1689-2519-3891.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Llanowar Mentor by paying {G}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Llanowar Elves creature token.
The Llanowar Elves token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Elrond.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Elrond trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

304-1636-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Tough Cookie.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
304-1636-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

1170-1329-1492-2534.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-2534.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Coercive Recruiter.
When Coercive Recruiter enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1445-5477-6965.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5477-6965.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-2350-2363-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-4770-6747-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

4875-5365-5641-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability and Basking Broodscale trigger, creating a Clue token and a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
4875-5365-5641-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Basking Broodscale for infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens

2403-2577-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2403-2577-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

509-1267-1379-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-1379-5547.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

1770-2788-3634-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1770-2788-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2957-3670-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2957-3670-4508.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, giving Ingenious Artillerist the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Imagecrafter, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

379-791-2125-2656-3939.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Varragoth.
Canal Dredger does not have summoning sickness.
379-791-2125-2656-3939.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol as many times as possible by paying all but 1 life, putting +1/+1 counters on creatures you control Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing all life totals to become 1.
Cast Temporal Extortion by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}.
If an opponent pays 1 life to counter it, that opponent's life total becomes 0, they lose the game, and you skip the next step.
Otherwise, resolve Temporal Extortion, gaining an extra turn.
Activate Canal Dredger by tapping it, putting Temporal Extortion from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Declare Varragoth as an attacker.
Activate Varragoth's Boast ability by paying {1}{B}, searching your library for Temporal Extortion and putting on top of your library.
Go to your next turn.
Draw Temporal Extortion in your draw step.
Repeat from step 7.

515-1636-4348.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.

1622-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce {5}{U}{U}.
1622-3542.description:
Cast Palinchron for {5}{U}{U}.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Minion Reflector.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
Activate the seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Resolve the Minion Reflector trigger, costing you {2} to create a copy of Palinchron.
The Palinchron copy enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
Activate the seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Activate the non-token Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

864-2104-2334.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
